project_summary: Typikon Coded: Ruthenian Typikon Logic Engine - Automating Byzantine liturgical calculation based on Dolnytsky's Typikon. Uses JSON-driven logic with 20 paradigms for feast ranking and service generation.

completed_milestones.title: Logic Core Complete (All Services)
completed_milestones.description: Implementation of logic gates for Vespers, Hours, Compline, Midnight Office, and Liturgy.

completed_milestones.title: Lenten Logic Gap Fixes
completed_milestones.description: Resolved critical logic gaps for Lenten Matins (Alleluia, Canon), Compline (Troparia), and Midnight Office.

completed_milestones.title: Menaion & Triodion Parsing and Ingestion
completed_milestones.description: Parsed and merged extensive text databases for the Menaion and Lenten Triodion cycles.

completed_milestones.title: Litiya & Royal Hours Logic and Structure
completed_milestones.description: Implemented full service structure JSON files and resolver functions for Litiya and Royal Hours.

completed_milestones.title: Octoechos & General Menaion Ingestion and Fallback
completed_milestones.description: Ingested all 8 Tones of the Octoechos (470 keys) and 21 saint classes of the General Menaion (175 keys). Fixed cascading fallback lookups and St. Timothy calendar logic.

completed_milestones.title: St. Sergius Recension Initial Import
completed_milestones.description: Implemented St. Sergius PDF downloader, clean text extractor, and procedural structurer mapping Tone 1 to text_st_sergius.json.

completed_milestones.title: Digest Purge & Error Safety
completed_milestones.description: Purged hardcoded canon logic/maps in typikon_digest_generator.py, re-implemented Ode 3/6 interludes dynamically, eliminated silent exception swallowing (pass), fixed beatitudes parameter mismatch, and verified all 255 tests passing.

completed_milestones.title: June 2026 Liturgical Remediation and 0-100 Multi-Audit
completed_milestones.description: Resolved Compline/Midnight Office suppresses, Matins Gradual duplication, Hours Troparia combination on Afterfeasts, Saturday morning lookahead capping, key leaks, and almanac consistency sync, achieving 100% pass on 318 tests.

completed_milestones.title: Backend-Driven UI Classification & Auditing Improvements
completed_milestones.description: Relocated all frontend classification logic to the Python backend; corrected [4 A+G] simple saint Class V mapping; added automated LLM UI Auditor sampling 15 dates.

completed_milestones.title: General Menaion Category Badging & Sunday Precedence
completed_milestones.description: Strict mapping of saint names to standard General Menaion categories (e.g. Forerunner -> Prophet badge); sequence-based Sunday readings override combination for Vigil/Polyeleos commemorations; implemented Apostles' Fast logic and Vespers stichera split rules.

completed_milestones.title: Draggable Column Resizing & Production Render Deployment
completed_milestones.description: Implemented draggable layout column handles for both main sidebar and split view with localStorage state persistence. Configured server.py for cloud deployment with dynamic PORT env binding and healthz checks, and created render.yaml blueprint for instant deployment on Render.com.

completed_milestones.title: Service Digest Styling, Citations, and Prokeimena Sourcing
completed_milestones.description: Implemented 'Say the Black, Do the Red' CSS styling; wrapped readings and verses in blockquotes with gold borders; extracted vestment and fasting metadata into pill badges; transformed source authority tags into tooltipped citations; dynamically sourced prokeimena from Horologion JSONs; mapped UGCC gendered saint prefixes; and implemented sanctuary rubrics filtering.

completed_milestones.title: 100% Part III Completeness & Doxa/LML Research
completed_milestones.description: Configured all 26 calendar and override dates for Part III of the master Dolnytsky Typikon across the monthly JSON databases, updated the annual 2026 almanac, completed verification with 337 tests passing cleanly, and documented comparative research on AGES Initiatives / Doxa LML architecture.

key_decisions.decision: Gate 5 Hypakoe/Anabathmoi are SEQUENTIAL, not mutually exclusive
key_decisions.rationale: Dolnytsky Part I Line 159 explicitly states: 'After the Hypakoe...the Gradual (Stepenna) of the current tone is sung'

key_decisions.decision: All encyclopedia documentation must cite specific Dolnytsky lines
key_decisions.rationale: Removes ambiguity and allows verification against source texts
Critical for upcoming Lenten season support.
